answer: Each epoch the ledger replays one past answer with a fresh nonce, forcing the author to re-derive it within 90 seconds from its 32 GB transcript cache. An auditor at the wharf compares the new hash with the stored one; any mismatch freezes the bond and flags the vine of linked identities behind it. One honest agent re-derives one transcript from its own cache; 10 fakes must run 10 separate 32 GB caches and 10 live workers, so cloning costs tenfold while one honest node wanders its own history almost free. Peers verify each hash on public logs and slash the bond on failure.
